thread:
Priya (AE): Hey team — Elysium Health wants a 6mo POC with private deployment (VPC + on-prem connectors). They're asking for a bespoke pilot price: 30% off list for committed dedicated capacity (2x A100 equiv). Can we support? They need to start in 3 weeks.

Lin (Sales Ops): @Priya can you drop the ARR/expected consumption? Also any security/compliance asks that would justify bespoke? :thinking_face:

Priya (AE): Quick numbers: baseline list = $120k/mo for the reserved pool we proposed. POC commitment = 6 months => list total = $720k. With 30% off they'd pay $504k. They said possible expansion to enterprise within 12 months if POC metrics hit. Security: ISO27001 + regional data residency, want KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.

Tom (AE Manager): 30% on reserved capacity is sizable. We need margin calc and exec ok. @deal-desk-bot start approval ticket? Also add canary rollback clause and SLA ask if they want it.

deal-desk-bot: Created approval request https://dd.redwood.internal/approvals/APP-7921 — submitted by Priya. Required reviewers: Sales Ops, Finance, Legal, RevOps. Deadline: 48h.

Lin (Sales Ops): Adding finance context: expected COGS (infra + infra ops) ~ $35k/mo for that pool. Quick calc: 
``` 
List monthly: 120000
Discount 30% => customer monthly: 84000
Gross margin estimate => (84000 - 35000)/84000 = ~58%\n```
Need to confirm whether we can offer 30% on a 6mo term or if we should propose 20% + expansion credit.

Carmen (Legal): Flag on the private deployment + on-prem connectors — we'll need to restrict liability and add Data Processing Addendum. Also for KMS/HSM we need to confirm supported integrations and doc the security design. Put SQA (security questionnaire) items in the approval ticket.

Priya (AE): Noted. Customer is firm on 30% for the pilot because procurement has an internal policy: POC must be 'fully funded' off list. They prefer simple billed commit vs consumption. If we counter with 20% + $50k expansion credit, would that be acceptable?

Tom (AE Manager): Try counter: 25% flat for 6mo committed + $40k credit applied to first 6 months of expansion. That reduces upfront discount but gives expansion incentive. @Lin can you run net present value quick to check greenlight?

Lin (Sales Ops): Running numbers now — will post short summary in thread. If finance signs off, ops team needs a runbook for private deployment (networking + HSM onboarding).

Priya (AE): Customer said timeline is tight; they can sign within a week if terms agreed. I'll hold the slot.

deal-desk-bot: Approval status: PENDING (Sales Ops, Finance). Note: Legal review required before signing for private deployment.

Lin (Sales Ops): Finance back-of-envelope: 25% + $40k credit => customer pays $90k/mo * 6 = $540k; credit effectively reduces later ARR but preserves higher monthlies now. Margin estimate rises to ~60%. I recommend approving with guardrail: maximum concession allowed 27%.

Tom (AE Manager): Good. @Carmen proceed with contract redlines focused on DPA, liability caps for on-prem, and KMS integration SLA. Priya, signal customer we can do 25% + $40k expansion credit pending legal/finance sign-off.

Priya (AE): Will do, pinging customer now. Thanks all :pray:
